items.description: Planar SE(2) hand-eye (algorithmBackend=managed; not OpenCV/JLVision). Fill samplesJson with robot/vision pose pairs → pose/transform; eye-in-hand or eye-to-hand. Key params: angularWeight, translation/angle residual gates. Rotation coverage and translation spans are reported as metrics, and a minimum of 8 deg rotation span plus 0.001 translation spread is required to avoid ill-conditioned planar fits. Needs rotation and translation in both streams; rejects duplicate robot poses; not 3D (use handEye3D). Failures: poor diversity, residual gates, near-pure translation.

items.description: Runs one native JLVision JlImage operator selected by the Operator parameter and returns the resulting image. This exposes the point-arithmetic, trigonometry, bitwise, filter and gray-morphology operators that previously had no node: the table covers abs/invert/sqrt/exp/log/pow/scale/gamma/convertType, sin/cos/tan/asin/acos/atan/atan2, add/sub/mult/div/absDiff/min/max, bit and/or/xor/not/shift/mask/slice, gauss/gaussImage/mean/binomial/medianRect/sigma/laplace/laplaceOfGauss/sobelAmp/smooth, gray erosion/dilation/opening/closing/top-hat/bottom-hat/skeleton/inside, channel compose/append/split and domain helpers, plus mean/deviation/equalisation/topographic/noise. Gray morphology uses image2 as the structuring element image and, when image2 is absent, generates a flat size x size structuring element; operators that need a second image use the connected image2 or fall back to the image itself, and an empty connected image2 fails. Pixel-type errors surface as a node error naming the operator and the parameters it consumes, never as a silent no-op.

items.description: Runs one native JLVision JlRegion operator on the input region and returns the resulting region. Covers set operations (complement/difference/backgroundSeg), structural morphology with an auto-generated rectangular structuring element (erosion/dilation/opening/closing/top-hat/bottom-hat/Minkowski/skeleton/SKIZ/pruning/rank/eliminateRuns/fitting), Golay thinning and thickening, geometric transforms (clip/move/zoom/mirror/transpose/partition/interjacent), selection and ordering (selectShapeStd/selectShapeProto/selectRegionPoint/sortRegion/expandRegion/removeNoiseRegion/fillUpShape/hammingChangeRegion), gray-driven selection, and region generators (rectangle2/ellipse/circle sector/line/polygon/checker/random/struct element). Ergonomics: no hand-drawn structuring element is required; Size drives a square SE, and reference-point operators read Row/Column. Region2 and Image inputs are validated before execution, so a missing input fails with an actionable message instead of a native error code.
